html:
G'oya

O'sib boruvchi yig'indini oyna funksiyasi bitta o'tishda hisoblaydi: baza har bir hisobning operatsiyalarini id bo'yicha tartiblaydi va yig'indini qatordan qatorga olib boradi. Korrelyatsiyalangan ichki so'rov esa har bir operatsiya uchun shu hisobning oldingi operatsiyalarini qaytadan qo'shib chiqadi. Hisobda ikki ming operatsiya bo'lsa, oxirgisi uchun ikki ming qator o'qiladi, hammasi uchun esa millionlab.

Yechim

SELECT id, account_id, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY id) AS balance
FROM transactions

PARTITION BY account_id har bir hisobni alohida hisoblaydi, ORDER BY id esa "shu operatsiyagacha" degan shartni beradi.

Tuzoqlar

Ichki so'rov to'g'ri, lekin account_id bo'yicha indeks bilan ham sekin. Indeks hisobning operatsiyalarini tez topadi, lekin ularni baribir har safar boshidan qo'shib chiqish kerak:

SELECT t.id, t.account_id, t.amount,
       (SELECT SUM(p.amount)
        FROM transactions p
        WHERE p.account_id = t.account_id AND p.id <= t.id) AS balance
FROM transactions t

PARTITION BY ni unutsangiz, hamma hisoblar bitta umumiy yig'indiga qo'shilib ketadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, account_id, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS balance
FROM transactions
